comparison.objective: Set a water meter with straight pipe runs of ten diameters upstream and five downstream; candidate removes four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Measure/arrange meter and pipe geometry versus precision mandrel alignment, hammer stabilization and striking, notch fracture, and loose-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Achieve the stated 10D/5D straight-run arrangement versus four contact-loaded fractures, physical containment of all tangs, and no insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: The record tests rule-based piping layout, not impact finishing of threaded inserts. Its body is very sparse and provides no attachment/tolerance rubric or spec versions, but the objectives are clearly unrelated.
